# The Hollywood Reporter

> > The Hollywood Reporter delivers breaking entertainment industry news, in-depth reviews, and exclusive coverage of film, television, streaming, music, and business developments.

The Hollywood Reporter is a leading entertainment trade publication covering Hollywood and the global entertainment industry. It features exclusive interviews, critical reviews, industry analysis, and breaking news about movies, TV shows, streaming platforms like Netflix, celebrity news, and business developments affecting the entertainment landscape.

## Key Topics

- Netflix
- Ryan Gosling
- Game of Thrones prequels
- Streaming platforms
- Film reviews
- TV series news
- Casting controversies
- Entertainment industry business
- Celebrity interviews
- Award shows coverage
- Diversity and representation
- International box office
- Music industry news
- Production updates
